_doc: OpenBuilds' drop-in tee nut for V-Slot, M5: "6 x 10.3 x 4.4mm", carbon steel. Put in anywhere along a V-Slot or C-Beam after the frame is built. It is the turned rhomboid other makers call a hammer nut. OpenBuilds gives no hold.
name: slot-nut-6-openbuilds-m5-drop-in

slot.rule: Made for V-Slot and C-Beam (the page: "add them to any location on a V-Slot or C-Beam Linear Rail")
slot.source: OpenBuilds Part Store, Drop-In Tee Nuts (10 Pack), product specifications, archived at https://web.archive.org/web/20230922050033/https://openbuildspartstore.com/drop-in-tee-nuts-10-pack/

thread.rule: M5 Thread Size, as the page gives it
thread.source: OpenBuilds Part Store, Drop-In Tee Nuts (10 Pack), product specifications, archived at https://web.archive.org/web/20230922050033/https://openbuildspartstore.com/drop-in-tee-nuts-10-pack/

nut_kind.rule: A drop-in tee nut: put in through the opening and turned
nut_kind.source: OpenBuilds Part Store, Drop-In Tee Nuts (10 Pack), product specifications, archived at https://web.archive.org/web/20230922050033/https://openbuildspartstore.com/drop-in-tee-nuts-10-pack/

length.rule: Along the slot: the 6 of "6 x 10.3 x 4.4mm"
length.source: OpenBuilds Part Store, Drop-In Tee Nuts (10 Pack), product specifications, archived at https://web.archive.org/web/20230922050033/https://openbuildspartstore.com/drop-in-tee-nuts-10-pack/

width.rule: Across the slot: the 10.3 of "6 x 10.3 x 4.4mm"
width.source: OpenBuilds Part Store, Drop-In Tee Nuts (10 Pack), product specifications, archived at https://web.archive.org/web/20230922050033/https://openbuildspartstore.com/drop-in-tee-nuts-10-pack/

height.rule: The body under the lips: the 4.4 overall less a 1 mm step, the step taken from the same rhomboid nut drawn by Motedis (S6BHASNM5): OpenBuilds gives only the overall height
height.source: OpenBuilds Part Store, Drop-In Tee Nuts (10 Pack), product specifications, archived at https://web.archive.org/web/20230922050033/https://openbuildspartstore.com/drop-in-tee-nuts-10-pack/; the step from Motedis' drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S6BHASNM5-Drawing.pdf

tongue_height.rule: The step into the opening: taken from the same rhomboid nut drawn by Motedis (S6BHASNM5)
tongue_height.source: Motedis, Hammermutter B Typ Nut 6 M5 (S6BHASNM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S6BHASNM5-Drawing.pdf

nut_entry.rule: Post build drop in (the page's words)
nut_entry.source: OpenBuilds Part Store, Drop-In Tee Nuts (10 Pack), product specifications, archived at https://web.archive.org/web/20230922050033/https://openbuildspartstore.com/drop-in-tee-nuts-10-pack/

material.rule: Material as the page names it
material.source: OpenBuilds Part Store, Drop-In Tee Nuts (10 Pack), product specifications, archived at https://web.archive.org/web/20230922050033/https://openbuildspartstore.com/drop-in-tee-nuts-10-pack/

hold.rule: Rexroth rates its T-nut in a 6 mm slot (M4) at 1700 N. An estimate until it is tested (Frames 2.13): the maker gives no figure for this nut
hold.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4 to 3-9; the proof stress from the kit's m5 thread set (ISO 898-1)
